{{Top|leg}}
The '''Organization for Droid and Machine Abuse''' was a group dedicated to [[Droid rights/Legends|stopping the exploitation and abuse]] of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The group was represented on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] star cruiser [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} Department 1007, on Civil Deck 10.

During his recounting of [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen's]] training mission involving the staged rescue of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]], the Rebel's droid, [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], suggested readers contact the organization to complain about the abuse of the R2.
